title: Export entry and product restructuring mechanism

source.request: Does export entry change what firms produce? Is product restructuring a mechanism behind productivity/environmental upgrading?
source.strategy:
Staggered DiD around export entry. 
Outcomes: number products, product HHI, product entry, product exit, core-product share.

question: Does starting to export change the products a factory makes?
rationale: Use a verified product panel and the R2 export-entry design to distinguish genuine product restructuring from recoding and reporting changes.
scope: Full exact Word row, interpreted through repository minimum checks and current owner full-plan ning/full-row acceptance gates. All analysis below is planned, not executed.
unit_of_analysis: Verified establishment×harmonized product×calendar-year source, then establishment-year product outcomes.

target_estimands.name: Primary requested target
target_estimands.formula: n_it = count{h: y_iht>0}; s_iht = y_iht/sum_h y_iht; HHI_it=sum_h s_iht^2; core_it=max_h s_iht

symbols.V: value added deflated with a certified appropriate price index; any single-output-deflator approximation is named
symbols.Y: gross output deflated with its certified output-price index
symbols.E: scope-defined verified physical energy in GJ; incomplete observed subtotals are separately named
symbols.C: scope-defined verified CO2 in metric tonnes; not automatically all greenhouse gases
symbols.L: workers under an annually verified employment definition
symbols.X: predetermined measured covariates declared for the particular design
symbols.g: verified treatment-entry cohort in calendar years
symbols.S: a verified trade, ownership, industry, or survival state; unknown is retained as unknown
symbols.s_iht: product share of the exact output denominator

target_estimands.interpretation: Counts measure observed product scope; HHI and core share measure output-value concentration. Entry and exit compare the same product definition across adjacent observed years.
target_estimands.limits: Changing product codes or reporting thresholds can mimic entry/exit. Value shares reflect prices as well as quantities. Product adjustments following export entry do not alone identify a causal mediation channel.

decisions.primary_family: Two outcomes (product count, HHI) by three post horizons = six tests; five secondary product outcomes by three horizons = 15 secondary tests.
decisions.product_price_sensitivity: A cross-product physical share is not meaningful when units differ. Use nominal output-value shares primary. Deflated product-value share is allowed only with a common-base certified product-specific price system; otherwise the indexed exhibit is a source-gap ledger.

secondary_outcome_definitions.product entry count: number of positive-value harmonized product codes present in t but not t−1, requiring complete modules at both actual years
secondary_outcome_definitions.product exit count: number present in t−1 but not t
secondary_outcome_definitions.core-product share: largest product output value divided by total comparable product output value
secondary_outcome_definitions.new-product output share: current value of entry products divided by current total comparable product output value
secondary_outcome_definitions.exited-product baseline share: previous-year value of exit products divided by previous-year comparable total

code_readability_and_progress_contract.comments: Non-executable Stata comments explain purpose, actual inputs, outputs and failure checks at file, block and subblock levels in simple Indonesian. Do not invent scientific interpretations.

code_readability_and_progress_contract.clock: Date-aware native Stata wall clock, one-second resolution; preserve scientific timers and fail certification on backward clock.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.semantics: Original operative source remains exactly recoverable; verify r(), e(), _rc, conditional branches and early transfers with a constructed runtime fixture before company execution.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.rerun: A documented launcher must run the actual preparation with visible progress before declaring data prep ready.

wave_input_contract.rule: Every company-data operand in analysis must be the single published consolidated master or a declared derivative whose entire company-data ancestry ends at that consolidated master. Direct annual-wave reads are prohibited in analysis; only the master builder may append annual waves. Raw/staged/legacy/cached final company files cannot be numerical analysis parents. A required field missing from the wave is an upstream preparation failure; never repair it by opening an external company file inside this row. Comparison-only validators may read older data but may not feed construction or estimates. External reference and metadata inputs retain explicit non-company roles.
